steps: Pressure cook the potato and beetroot in water for 2 to 3 whistles on medium, until a fork goes in easily, then peel them.
Grate the potato, beetroot and paneer into a bowl.
Dry roast the cumin on low until it smells toasty, crush it, and chop the coriander leaves fine.
Mix everything with the oats into a soft dough.
Shape into about 4 small, flat rounds a child, each small enough for a little hand to hold.
Heat the oil in a flat pan on medium-low and cook the tikkis 3 to 4 minutes a side, until golden.
Cool until just warm before serving.
note: No salt, chilli or chaat masala. Paneer helps bind and oats take the place of breadcrumbs or sooji.
